# Jobli

> Jobli (https://www.jobli.it) is an AI-powered CV/resume tool for job
> seekers. You upload your CV as a PDF; Jobli scores it, rewrites it to be
> clearer and ATS-readable, turns it into a shareable profile page, tailors
> it to a specific job posting, and exports it as an ATS-safe PDF or Word
> file. It is operated from Milan, Italy, primarily in Italian, with a full
> English interface. It is currently in beta and free to use.

The core guarantee: **Jobli never invents information that is not in your
CV.** No skill, employer, date, qualification or number is ever added. Every
AI stage (extraction, improvement, job tailoring, translation, chat
refinement) is constrained to rephrasing and reorganising what the user
actually wrote. Output is AI-generated, not human-reviewed, and users are
told to check it before sending it anywhere.

## The CV score

A CV is scored 0-100 as the sum of exactly four criteria, each worth up to
25 points:

1. **Quantified results** (risultati misurabili): how many achievements
   carry concrete numbers or percentages, and how many bullets open with a
   strong action verb.
2. **Clarity** (chiarezza): how clear the professional summary is, and how
   readable the experience section is.
3. **ATS structure** (struttura ATS): how well the original document's
   layout can be parsed by automated screening systems, penalising tables,
   multiple columns and text boxes.
4. **Specific skills** (competenze specifiche): how many concrete technical
   skills are named explicitly, and how many are also demonstrated inside
   the experience entries rather than merely listed.

## Features

- **CV scoring**: a 0-100 score on the four criteria above, plus suggested
  roles that match the experience already in the CV.
- **AI improvement**: the bio and experience bullets are rewritten to be
  clearer and more concrete, then re-scored so the before/after difference
  is visible.
- **Public profile page**: a shareable web page generated from the CV, in
  one of 4 visual styles. Real email and phone are always shown redacted on
  the public page. The page is not search-indexed.
- **ATS-optimised PDF export**: 3 deliberately plain single-column
  templates (Pragmatico, Executive, Creative Tech). An optional paid add-on
  compacts the result onto a single page.
- **Word (.docx) export**: the same CV as an editable document.
- **Job tailoring**: paste a job posting (or a link to one) and the CV is
  rewritten to align with that role, using only what the user declared. A
  relevance check warns first when the CV does not fit the posting.
- **Cover letter generation**: a cover letter written from the CV and the
  job posting.
- **Translation**: the CV or the cover letter translated into English,
  Spanish, French, German, Portuguese or Italian.
- **Interview preparation**: from a job posting, a research report on the
  hiring company (what it does, its market, its culture, recent news, the
  posting's own critical points, and likely interview questions). This one
  feature does browse the live web, via Anthropic's web-search and web-fetch
  tools, and every claim is returned with the source URL that was actually
  visited. It deliberately does not read the user's CV.
- **CV chat**: a short question-and-answer chat that fills gaps in a CV by
  asking the user about missing details, then folds the answers back in.

## Credits

Each new account gets 3 free credits (one welcome bonus per email address).
There is currently no way to buy credits; users can request 10 more for free
from their account, reviewed by hand. Current costs:

| Action | Credits |
| --- | --- |
| PDF download | 1 |
| Word (.docx) download | 1 |
| Cover letter generation | 1 |
| Translation (CV or cover letter) | 1 |
| CV chat refinement | 1 |
| Interview preparation report | 2 |
| One-page PDF compaction (add-on) | 0.5 |

Uploading a CV, scoring it, improving it, generating the profile page and
tailoring it to a job posting are all free. A credit is charged the first
time a given result is produced; re-downloading the same file afterwards is
free.

## Privacy

The uploaded PDF itself is not kept; only the structured text extracted from
it is, linked to the account. An upload that is never linked to an account
is deleted after 1 hour. Users can delete a single CV or their whole account
themselves, immediately and irreversibly. The service is for people aged 14
and over.
